candidates.exact_span: There shall be no discharge of floating solids or visible foam in other than trace amounts.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Establishes a non-numeric effluent limitation; interpretation of 'trace amounts' and what constitutes a discharge of floating solids or visible foam could change whether reported observations are treated as exceeding an applicable limit versus being outside numeric comparison.

candidates.exact_span: There shall be no discharge of visible films of oil, globules of oil, grease or solids in or on the water, or coatings on stream banks.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Establishes qualitative oil/grease/solids limitations; different readings of 'visible films,' 'globules,' or 'coatings on stream banks' could change which observations are flagged as limit exceedances.

candidates.exact_span: Samples taken in compliance with the monitoring requirements specified above shall be taken at the discharge from the final treatment unit prior to the receiving stream.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Specifies mandatory sample location; interpretation of 'final treatment unit,' 'discharge,' and which upstream 'monitoring requirements specified above' govern could change which measurements are valid for limit comparison (A) and whether monitoring was performed at a required location (B).

candidates.exact_span: Achieve Final Effluent Limitations 12 months after permit effective date
candidates.computation_change_reason: Defers enforceability of cyanide effluent limitations to a date tied to permit effective date; a different effective-date interpretation changes whether cyanide numeric limits are applicable during all or part of Federal FY2025.

candidates.exact_span: The permittee shall submit a progress report to both EPA and NMED outlining the status of the activities (i.e., analyzers installation, Process Optimization Study, etc.) during the months of January, April, July, and October, of each year, until compliance is achieved as stated above.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Imposes recurring reporting obligations conditioned on not yet having achieved final cyanide limitations; interpretation of when 'compliance is achieved' ends this duty could change which FY2025 months require progress reports.

candidates.exact_span: No later than 14 calendar days following the date for compliance for Cyanide effluent limitations, the permittee shall submit a written notice of compliance or noncompliance.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Creates a time-bound reporting requirement keyed to the cyanide compliance deadline; the computed compliance date and whether the notice was due within FY2025 depend on permit effective-date interpretation.

candidates.exact_span: The permittee shall achieve compliance with the TDS net increase effluent concentration limit of 449 mg/L 3 years after the permit effective date.
candidates.computation_change_reason: States an enforceable numeric TDS limit and a deferred applicability trigger; different readings of 'net increase effluent concentration,' the 449 mg/L value, or the three-year start date change which FY2025 measurements are subject to numeric comparison.

candidates.exact_span: Upgrading City’s WTP #1 and removing its discharge to the City’s WWTP
candidates.computation_change_reason: Ties compliance activities to a specific discharge pathway (WTP #1 to WWTP); interpretation of whether that discharge still exists or was removed affects which discharge points/parameters have applicable limits (A), which monitoring obligations attach (B), and whether periods should be classified as documented no-discharge (C).

candidates.exact_span: Complete constructions and cease discharging                 November 2024
candidates.computation_change_reason: Sets a scheduled cessation of WTP #1 discharge before/during FY2025; whether discharge actually ceased by this date changes applicable limits and monitoring for that point (A,B) and whether later missing data reflects a documented no-discharge state versus unresolved evidence (C).
